z-ai/glm-5.3-flash.description: Recommended - the only model Pareto serves; GLM 5.3 Flash (Zhipu/Z.ai), run on Pareto's own GPUs. Confirmed live via an unauthenticated GET https://api.paretoinference.com/v1/models on 2026-09-28 (HTTP 200, exactly one id: z-ai/glm-5.3-flash, owned_by z-ai) - no key used, matching the docs' note that GET /models needs no API key. The docs also document a bare alias, glm-5.3-flash, for the same model (https://docs.paretoinference.com/api-reference, retrieved 2026-09-28). Wire is OpenAI Chat Completions: POST /chat/completions with required model + messages ('Use the OpenAI message format'), the answer read from choices[0].message.content, SSE streaming with text in choices[0].delta.content and tool calls in choices[0].delta.tool_calls, a final usage event when stream_options.include_usage is true, and a terminal 'data: [DONE]' (https://docs.paretoinference.com/api-reference, retrieved 2026-09-28). Output tokens (max_tokens / max_completion_tokens - send only one) range 1-131,072, defaulting to 131,072 when both are omitted - that figure is this entry's defaultMaxOutputTokens and maxOutputTokens. Pareto documents no separate context-length figure anywhere: 'We do not disclose the technical details of our GLM 5.3 Flash serving system' (https://docs.paretoinference.com/how-pareto-works, retrieved 2026-09-28), and no context-window number appears on the quickstart, API reference, how-it-works, errors, or pricing pages, so models.defaultContextWindow above (131,072) is a catalog fallback that reuses the documented output ceiling - not a vendor-stated context length and not a known floor under the real one - correct it once Pareto publishes one or an authenticated probe reveals one; contextWindow is deliberately left unset on this model entry rather than restating that same undocumented fallback as a per-model fact. Pricing from https://docs.paretoinference.com/pricing, retrieved 2026-10-02: $0.09 per 1M input tokens, $0.30 per 1M output tokens, $0.018 per 1M cached-input tokens ('a cache hit is not guaranteed'); GET https://api.paretoinference.com/v1/models reports the same three figures. The 2026-09-28 onboarding recorded $0.03 / $0.10 / $0.006. The vendor prices this model as a discount to OpenRouter's listing, so it can move; recheck before relying on it. tools ('Sends OpenAI function tools') and response_format ('Requests a structured response') are both documented request parameters, but the same request-parameters table hedges both of them - plus tool_choice and logprobs - with 'Model support can differ'; there is no model-specific confirmation for z-ai/glm-5.3-flash and no live probe was possible credential-free, so capabilities.tools is 'model-dependent' here and toolsWithStreaming/structuredOutput/structuredOutputWithTools are left false rather than asserted from a hedged parameter table. reasoning_effort ('Sets the reasoning level') is documented as a plain, unhedged request parameter - unlike tools/response_format/tool_choice/logprobs it carries no 'Model support can differ' caveat - which is the basis for capabilities.thinking: true. Vision/image input and an embeddings endpoint are not documented anywhere on docs.paretoinference.com, so vision stays false and models.visionModel is left unset. No live capability probe was run: this is credential-free onboarding, no Pareto API key was ever created, and no POST request was ever sent to the vendor - see evidence.liveMatrix: null.

errorRules.message: Invalid Pareto Inference API key. Check {apiKeyEnvVar}. Pareto documents 401 as "the chat API key is missing, invalid, or no longer active" (unauthenticated GET /models needs no key, so this only affects POST /chat/completions) but publishes no example error body - get or replace a key at {setupUrl}

Pareto rate/credit limit hit for {model}. Documented causes: credit_exhausted (no credits left - buy more), credit_insufficient (held credits below what max_tokens could use - lower max_tokens or buy credits), or model_capacity (the model is at capacity, not an account limit - honor Retry-After). See {setupUrl}

setup.description: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint at https://api.paretoinference.com/v1, serving exactly one hosted model - z-ai/glm-5.3-flash (GLM 5.3 Flash), also reachable via the documented alias glm-5.3-flash - on Pareto's own GPUs. No free tier: a payment card and prepaid credits are required before a key is issued. Pareto offers zero data retention (ZDR) and does not keep request content after a request finishes.
